editorial:
Imagine finding out your spouse has moved out to live with a new partner, only to realize that your marriage is more complicated than you thought. That is exactly where you start with this story. You follow a husband who is desperate to get his wife back, even though she has been happily living with her female lover for half a year. It is a quirky, awkward, and funny look at love and jealousy. The vibe is very lighthearted, making you laugh at how ridiculous the husband acts while he tries to play it cool and win her over.

You will really enjoy the acting here because the chemistry between the three leads feels very real and messy. The pacing is snappy, so you never get bored, though some of the romantic logic is a bit silly. If you like comedies that deal with weird relationship triangles, you should definitely check this one out. Since it is an older flick, you might want to look for a high-quality version.
endingExplained: In the end, the husband realizes that he cannot simply force his wife back into their old life. After a series of funny and tense encounters, the wife chooses to stay true to her own feelings and her new partner. The movie wraps up with a sense of acceptance. Instead of a traditional happy ending where the couple reunites, you see a more honest conclusion where everyone accepts their new roles in each other's lives.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic comedies with a weird twist.
